options.name: Order of the Cockatrice
options.benefit: Pursue personal glory; gain Braggart, Steal Glory, and Moment of Triumph.

options.name: Order of the Dragon
options.benefit: Serve loyal allies; gain Aid Allies, Strategy, and Act as One.

options.name: Order of the Lion
options.benefit: Serve a sovereign; gain Lion's Call, For the King, and Shield of the Liege.

options.name: Order of the Shield
options.benefit: Protect common folk; gain Resolute, Stem the Tide, and Retribution.

options.name: Order of the Star
options.benefit: Serve a faith; gain Calling, For the Faith, and Retribution.

options.name: Order of the Sword
options.benefit: Uphold honour; gain By My Honor, Mounted Mastery, and Knight's Challenge.
